name: The Cat
notes: A channel with a cat in it. No house, no rooms, no mention of either. Opened by /start-game.

name: A Place to Sleep
notes: The cat bed appears in the channel, and with it /look and /use.

name: Something to Play With
notes: The cat toy, /take and /inventory. Not built yet; defined here because content already waits on it.

name: A Craving
notes: The craving game, and nothing else. The cat wants a particular food today, and players guess it by putting emoji reactions on her messages. Numbered 3 so it can run on the QA servers with /qa-drop before beta. Renumbered 26 October.

name: The Door
notes: Was drop 3. The cat leads players into the Entryway: coat rack, the salmon stash behind it, front door, ceiling. One quest, feeding the cat. Renumbered 26 October; drops after 3 are numbered in tens to leave room between them.

name: The Rest of the Hall
notes: Was drop 4. The rest of the Entryway: intercom, shipping box and spice jars, mirror, stroller, shoes, booties, lumber and the ruined staircase. David's name first appears on the box's packing slip. Starts the staircase repair: 90 planks by default (config staircase_planks), one per player per day. Alexa and the bulletin board were held back on 29 October and sit at 99 until a later drop is picked.

name: Through the Arch
notes: The Dining Room and the Kitchen and everything in them, the arched doorway from the Entryway and the swinging door between them, the can opener, two more cat-food flavors. Deliberately not the back door: the Courtyard is still drop 30, and a split that let players out of the kitchen would be the whole ground floor again. Added 31 October.

name: The Ground Floor
notes: Was drop 5. Courtyard and Living Room with everything in them, the wide doorway from the Entryway and the back door out of the Kitchen, the chicken cat food, and the bottle and diaper scatter. The to-do list was held back on 30 October and sits at 99 until a later drop is picked, the same way Alexa and the bulletin board do. The kitchen tuna stash went the same day: the dining room sideboard holds tuna now rather than salmon, so salmon comes from the Entryway alone.

name: The Ladder
notes: Added 2 November. The ladder alone, held back out of drop 30 so that beta can finish playtesting the ground floor before anybody can see the upstairs windows from the top of it. Where the ladder's own mechanics will go when they are designed

name: Upstairs
notes: Was drop 6. The Upstairs Hallway and the Bedroom, reached only by the repaired grand staircase; the kitchen back stairs were deleted on 30 October. The Nursery was split out into drop 45 on 7 November, so that beta can read two rooms before the third - the same reasoning that held the ladder back out of drop 30. Meant to open on the staircase repair rather than by command; until that is built it is advanced like the rest.

name: The Nursery
notes: Added 7 November, split out of drop 40. The Nursery, the nursery door in both directions, and the two drop-40 achievements that need what is in there: Baby Talk wants the baby monitor and Accompanist wants the music box. The Upstairs Hallway is described twice on purpose - drop 40 names one doorway and drop 45 names both, and the later row supersedes it, because a paragraph promising a door nobody can open is worse than a shorter paragraph. Numbered 45 for the reason 25 and 31 are numbered where they are: a split lands between the tens.

name: The Toy Box
notes: Added 11 November. The other ten toys from the toy bank, the catnip mouse and its buff among them. Toys leave the road for containers all over the house, six out at a time, and the cat carries off one stale toy per spot per day. Easily Amused, Whole Toy Box and Playgroup. Numbered 46 so it lands after the Nursery and before the Secret Library.

name: The Last Door
notes: Was drop 7. The Secret Library and the two passages into it, per-player discovery as Phase 2e specifies.
